title: Receipt Printer (std::format)
hints: A replacement field is {:[fill][align][sign][#][0][width][.precision][type]}. Align: < left, > right, ^ centre.
receipt_line: "{:<12.12}{:>3} x {:>8.2f} = {:>9.2f}". For a string, .12 is a MAXIMUM length (truncation); for a double, .2 is the number of decimals.
hex_byte: "0x{:02x}" - but format an unsigned int, not the unsigned char itself. pad_id: "{:06}".
